title: The summary for Thursday 26 November
text:
Good morning, it is Thursday 26 November: this is the GERICO summary.

The Houthis in Yemen say they have attacked the Saudi refinery in Ras Tanura and the financial district of Riyadh. The Saudi-led coalition claims to have intercepted two ballistic missiles aimed at the capital. The damage has not been verified.

In Ukraine, Russia has struck Kyiv with ballistic missiles: seven injured, according to the city administration. American President Trump and NATO Secretary General Rutte are asking Moscow not to expand the war.

In Israel, judges have suggested that the prosecution drop the most serious corruption case against Prime Minister Netanyahu. The Attorney General will now decide.

Today in Brussels, European leaders are discussing the budget from 2028 to 2034 and the €45 billion loan for Ukraine.

The United States is proposing a ten per cent tariff on Brazilian aircraft.

Let us move on to the markets. Yesterday Wall Street closed mixed: the Dow Jones gained half a point, the Nasdaq lost almost one point. Piazza Affari fell by almost two points and the spread between BTPs and Bunds rose to 112 bp. Oil closed at almost $84. This morning Tokyo rebounded by over 1.5%. Today the United States is closed for Thanksgiving.

Among today's events: at 10:15 the summit of European leaders, at 13:30 the ECB minutes.

The full news, with sources, is on GERICO. No investment advice.
